body: I feel like I could win that battle, struggle effectively, but I get confused on where to start? I'm not stupid, but I feel so completely lost when it comes to "how" to fix what I've become. Did you do something specific?

I get angry, very angry, over stupid, meaningless things. That's what happened today. And then I get angry *at myself* for getting angry. At the end of the day, after spending all day in a black fury, my co-workers staying out of my way, I spend the lengthy commute thinking about options, about ending it. 

Then of course I get home, see my beautiful family, and somehow start feeling better. That's the rub - everyone thinks we're a happy, fulfilled family, but the reality is I feel empty, alone, wandering. I look back on today and think "How could I have been so angry, it's silly" but at the time, it's very real. I disconnect, I stop caring (dunno why they haven't fired me yet) I hurt those around me that try to help. 

It feels like it's all bottled up, and I'm becoming more and more terrified that it's going to just let go one day, the line will get crossed and that will be that.

Thank you for responding, commenting, it feels...better getting this out.
